[2024 fall ms probability — problem 1]

$X$ has pmf $P(X=x) = c(2x+1)$ for $x = 0,1,2$. (1) Find $c$. (2) Compute $P(X=2)$. (3) $\mathbb{E}[X]$. (4) $\operatorname{Var}(X)$. (5) For 10 i.i.d. copies, find the distribution of the maximum. (6) Compute $P(\min(X_1,\dots,X_{10}) > 0)$.

response.text:
# Solution

**Setup:** PMF values are $P(X=0)=c$, $P(X=1)=3c$, $P(X=2)=5c$.

## (1) Find $c$

$$\sum P(X=x) = c+3c+5c = 9c = 1 \implies \boxed{c = \tfrac{1}{9}}$$

## (2) $P(X=2)$

$$P(X=2) = 5c = \boxed{\tfrac{5}{9}}$$

## (3) $\mathbb{E}[X]$

$$\mathbb{E}[X] = 0\cdot\tfrac{1}{9} + 1\cdot\tfrac{3}{9} + 2\cdot\tfrac{5}{9} = \boxed{\tfrac{13}{9}}$$

## (4) $\operatorname{Var}(X)$

$$\mathbb{E}[X^2] = 0 + 1\cdot\tfrac{3}{9} + 4\cdot\tfrac{5}{9} = \tfrac{23}{9}$$

$$\operatorname{Var}(X) = \tfrac{23}{9} - \left(\tfrac{13}{9}\right)^2 = \tfrac{207-169}{81} = \boxed{\tfrac{38}{81}}$$

## (5) Distribution of $M = \max(X_1,\dots,X_{10})$

CDF of $X$: $F(0)=\tfrac{1}{9}$, $F(1)=\tfrac{4}{9}$, $F(2)=1$.

By independence, $P(M\le k) = F(k)^{10}$:

$$P(M=0) = \left(\tfrac{1}{9}\right)^{10}$$

$$P(M=1) = \left(\tfrac{4}{9}\right)^{10} - \left(\tfrac{1}{9}\right)^{10}$$

$$P(M=2) = 1 - \left(\tfrac{4}{9}\right)^{10}$$

## (6) $P(\min > 0)$

$$P(\min > 0) = P(X_1 \ge 1)^{10} = \left(\tfrac{8}{9}\right)^{10} \approx 0.3079$$
